passage:
For the school art show, each student had to draw a picture about "home." Most students drew houses, families, or bedrooms.
Max drew a bus stop. Some classmates thought it was strange.
Max explained that his parents worked late, so his grandmother picked him up at the bus stop every day. They talked there, shared snacks, and watched people walk by. To him, that place felt like home.
The art teacher placed Max's picture near the entrance. Many visitors stopped to look at it because it was different.
Max learned that a topic can have more than one answer. Home is not always a building. Sometimes it is a person, a habit, or a place where someone waits for you.
